title: Cannot interact with Claude Code interface on Windows
body:
## Environment
- OS: Windows 11
- Terminal: PowerShell, Command Prompt, and WSL (Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS)
- npm version: 10.9.2
- Git version: 2.47.1.windows.2

## Issue Description
I'm experiencing issues with Claude Code on Windows. While I can install the package and launch it, I cannot interact with the interface. The terminal displays the welcome message and selection menu but doesn't accept any input. When I try to use commands like `/help` or `/config`, they're interpreted by my shell rather than by Claude Code.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Installed Claude Code globally: `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`
2. Ran the command: `npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code` (also tried `claude`)
3. The UI appears with text style selection options, but I cannot interact with it
4. Any commands typed are processed by the underlying shell, not by Claude Code

## Error Message
Consistently receiving this error before the UI appears:

TRIED Claude in every SHELL, WSL, Terminal Environment and did not work  - Only ERROR messages. 
Unable to interact with Claude Coding.

  errno: -4058,
  code: 'ENOENT',
  syscall: 'spawn /bin/bash',
  path: '/bin/bash',
  spawnargs: [ '-l' ]
}

top_comments.author: wolffiex
top_comments.body:
Claude Code is intended to work in WSL and not Powershell, but obviously we have some problems. We have some fixes coming. In the meantime, it may help do this:
`SHELL=/bin/bash claude`

top_comments.author: lhiebert01
top_comments.body:
50 more attempts to install - To summarize what we've found:

Claude Code is installed correctly (verified with npm list -g)
Bash exists and has proper permissions in your WSL environment
Both in Windows and WSL, you get the /bin/bash ENOENT error
You also encounter a syntax error in the JavaScript module

Given that Claude Code is still in research preview/beta status, these kinds of compatibility issues aren't surprising. The best approach at this point is to:

Report the issue to Anthropic by
